purpose: A micronaut profile is a projection. It may bias routing; it may not become a relation, a commit, or schema truth. The boundary is a type, and a malformed profile is refused by name instead of being dropped.

schema_guard.rule: every profile key is typed as ProjectionOnlyObject, so a non-object profile is a schema error, not a silent omission

diagnostics.rule: a rejected track or a dropped profile is named; nothing is discarded silently

PROFILE1.name: projection_is_a_type
PROFILE1.check: profile_projection is ProjectionOnly<util::JsonPtr>; there is no implicit conversion to the value

PROFILE2.name: schema_types_every_profile_key
PROFILE2.check: brain_profile, personality, capability_grams, progression all resolve to ProjectionOnlyObject

PROFILE3.name: no_silent_profile_loss
PROFILE3.check: a malformed profile is a typed diagnostic (track_schema_rejected / profile_not_object), never an empty projection

PROFILE4.name: shipped_tracks_are_clean
PROFILE4.check: loading every shipped track produces no profile_not_object and no track_parse_failed diagnostic
